answer: Filling 62 aliases thus needs 62 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Because the rationale is hashed into the opal record and indexed in the gale history, the ridge audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 2 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
